classification.attribution: Explains an already-frozen portfolio/result; MUST cite source result hashes; no new strategy selection or promotion. Reading a frozen result without a local return producer is derived analysis.
classification.derived_analysis_only: Reads one or more frozen result files, cites their hashes, and performs bootstrap, attribution, synthesis, or reconciliation without producing a new return path.
classification.diagnostic_simulation: External-data, ETF, overlay, or other custom simulation retained only as diagnostic/negative knowledge; MUST explicitly state no project execution claim and no promotion, even if a stock sleeve was separately run through the formal engine.
classification.feasibility_probe: Tests external data availability or coverage; MUST identify external source and may not claim tradability or portfolio performance.
classification.private_runtime: User-owned data/strategies/custom; not repository research evidence.
classification.project_formal: Produces portfolio return, drawdown, Sharpe, or strategy conclusion using project data and strategy engine. Direct calls MUST use StrategyBacktestService.run_with_evidence and require_formal_evidence; an indirect call is allowed only when the runner uses a repository helper that itself calls run_with_evidence and require_formal_evidence.
classification.statistical_screen: Produces factor IC, correlation, coverage, statistical admission, or parameter-statistical evidence; MUST use project data and declared statistical method; may not claim portfolio return/strategy conclusion.

prohibitions: No result may be labeled project_formal without run_with_evidence persistence=saved.
No runner may compute portfolio returns with a hand-written simulator and call it a strategy conclusion.
No diagnostic result may promote active_version or generate orders/paper targets.
No strategy may be public unless research_only is explicitly false; research strategies default true.
No result file may be rewritten without a new dated version and a hash-linked amendment.
No hand-written ETF, overlay, or return simulator may be classified as derived_analysis_only.
No research runner may omit a standard research type; diagnostics must be explicit.
No diagnostic runner may be counted as a project portfolio result merely because part of its inputs came from the project data store.
